faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: For any unanswered questions, reach out to our support team via email. We'll respond as soon as possible to assist you.

items.q: How secure is my data with Healix?
items.a: Your privacy is our priority. Healix uses advanced encryption to protect your data and you have full control over it.

items.q: Can I use Healix without any wearable devices?
items.a: Yes, Healix can be used without wearables. You can manually log your health data or use your smartphone's sensors.

items.q: What's included in the doctor chat support?
items.a: Doctor chat support allows you to consult with licensed health professionals directly through the app.

items.q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
items.a: Absolutely. You can change your plan at any time from your account settings with no extra fees.

items.q: Does Healix offer a free trial?
items.a: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial on all plans. No credit card required to get started.
